records.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 6 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tag-init. Tumatagal ng 6 na araw upang mahinog.

records.source: A freshwater trout with colorful markings.
records.translation: Trutsa sa tubig-tabang na may makukulay na marka.

records.source: Activate to greatly increase the chance for rain tomorrow. Consumed on use.
records.translation: Gamitin upang lubhang pataasin ang tsansang umulan bukas. Nauubos kapag ginamit.

records.source: It's said to be the Junimos' favorite food.
records.translation: Sinasabing ito ang paboritong pagkain ng mga Junimo.

records.source: A heavy black disc studded with peculiar red stones. When you hold it, you're overwhelmed with a feeling of dread.
records.translation: Mabigat at itim na diskong kinalupkupan ng kakaibang mga pulang bato. Kapag hinawakan mo ito, nilulukob ka ng matinding pangamba.

records.source: Sow in fall. Takes all season to grow.
records.translation: Itanim sa taglagas. Inaabot ng buong panahon bago ito lumaki.

records.source: Often used in salads and coleslaws. The color can range from purple to blue to green-yellow depending on soil conditions.
records.translation: Madalas gamitin sa mga ensalada at coleslaw. Maaaring maging lila, bughaw, o luntiang-dilaw ang kulay nito depende sa kalagayan ng lupa.
records.englishResidueReason: Coleslaw is the conventional Filipino culinary loanword for this specific cabbage salad.

records.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 9 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tag-init. Tumatagal ng 9 na araw upang mahinog.

records.source: Long ago these were kept as pets.
records.translation: Noong unang panahon, inaalagaan ang mga ito bilang alagang hayop.

records.source: A spotted mushroom sometimes found in caves.
records.translation: Batik-batik na kabuteng paminsan-minsang matatagpuan sa mga kuweba.

records.englishResidueReason: Antioxidant is the conventional scientific loanword in Filipino health and nutrition contexts.
Slime is the canonical Filipino glossary's retained creature name.

records.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
records.translation: Maaaring mapisa sa Pampapisa ng Slime.
records.englishResidueReason: Slime is the canonical Filipino glossary's retained creature name.

records.source: A popular fish with a nice red color.
records.translation: Sikat na isdang may magandang pulang kulay.

records.source: A more pure form of quartz.
records.translation: Mas dalisay na anyo ng kuwarts.

records.source: The stalks are extremely tart, but make a great dessert when sweetened.
records.translation: Napakaasim ng mga tangkay nito, ngunit napakasarap gawing panghimagas kapag pinatamis.

records.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 13 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 13 araw upang mahinog.

records.source: A basic grain often served under vegetables.
records.translation: Pangunahing butil na madalas ihain sa ilalim ng mga gulay.

records.source: It's creamy, sweet, and fun to eat.
